notes.title: Version 1.01 Hotfix
notes.content:
A small update has just been released for RED Fuse, the patch notes are below.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
 [*]Doublecross Cavern has been tweaked to prevent bombs from getting stuck on certain objects. 
 [*]Fixed a bug on the level select map that may have prevented the next cave icon from appearing when changing layers.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Doublecross Cavern has been tweaked to prevent bombs from getting stuck on certain objects.
[*]Fixed a bug on the level select map that may have prevented the next cave icon from appearing when changing layers.
